essence:
Having established the reflexive-awareness (vimarśa) as the manifestation's nature
and as the parā-vāk (V2-H), Abhinavagupta now gives the positive account of the powers.

The speech (vāk) and the mind (manas) — their motion — are only the ahaṅkāra-vṛtti (the ego-operation),
like the hand; so how could they be the param?
